title: GC-IR Reference Implementation — reproducibility artifact for "From Risk Register to Runtime Predicate"

creators.name: Gill-Lakhowal, Abhinandan
creators.affiliation: Gillian Holdings Incorporated, Calgary, AB, Canada

description:
Reference implementation and empirical artifact for a deterministic method that compiles approved AI governance assessments into enforceable runtime predicates.

Implements the governed semantic refinement relation Ψ_K, closed into a mapping only by a signed judgment record; the GC-IR record family with total risk disposition; the deterministic compiler Φ with RFC 8785 canonicalization and SHA-256 bundle hashing; authority closure against an approved action matrix; the consequence-class gate coverage rule; a separately signed lifecycle registry; and a temporally valid traceability model with six audit queries.

Ships two hash-pinned worked cases (Case A synthetic; Case B a forensic reconstruction), a 62-case adversarial corpus, property-based tests, and the preregistered Tier-0 evaluation campaign whose reportable results are in results/final_v2/, executed after the public preregistration freeze preregister-tier0-v2.2.

Claim boundary. The comparative expert study (RQ5) is preregistered and deferred: no adjudication panel has been convened and no participant data exists. Determinism is measured across eight tested environments and is not a claim of platform independence. No detection performance, production deployment or independent validation is claimed.
notes: The article this artifact supports is under submission; its DOI is not yet assigned and is deliberately not asserted here. The authoritative empirical campaign is results/final_v2/, governed by the public preregistration freeze preregister-tier0-v2.2 at commit c44f25d6fdb67e0bc4ac73a6217125dec8da1c0e.
